about_the_game:
OVERVIEW

Beneath the roaring 1898 frontier expansion lies the cries of those who are left behind. Follow the disgraced ex-ranger, The Drifter, on his path to redemption as he attempts to root out the corruption of a failing state. Acting as his unexpected partner is The Enforcer, a bold ranger scout with dreams of an equitable future. Together, they'll leverage the lessons of a tragic past and the ambitions of a hopeful tomorrow to overcome a present rife with outlaws and obstinate officers.

COMBAT

  • Navigate immersive maps.

  • Strategically position your allies.

  • Duke it out in hectic brawls.

  • Nail the timing for tense quickdraws.

  • Line up the perfect shot to sack a faraway foe.

COLORFUL COMPANIONS

Against stacked odds, grit your teeth and stand tall alongside fierce comrades. Spend time with them throughout your campaign to bolster bonds and witness their growth on and off the battlefield.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: blood, depiction of suicide and criminal activities, 
use of alcohol and tobacco, references to abortion, and other general mature content.

name: Drifter Dynasty
short_description: Drifter Dynasty is a strategy role-playing game featuring thrilling brawls and tense duels. A lone drifter meets a willful ranger at the crossroads of a political power struggle. The stage is set for a multi-generational Western epic. Will you saddle up for a new frontier?
